harness: probe service (tools/stallfloor/probe.py): frozen kernel families, every thread of every launch judged against a host-computed checksum
what: a guarded wait under ANOTHER predicate (kind gp): two LDC.64 under two different predicates on ONE write barrier, the ONLY wait on that barrier on an instruction under the first predicate (the carrier), the reader under the second predicate with no wait of its own, its result folded into the checksum as data; form imad in three barrier layouts and form lea; which side executes: both | the reader's only | the carrier's only | neither | two bits of the lane | two bits of the iteration counter; the predicates set in the prologue or 13 / 12 cycles in front of the first load; every request with the carrier's wait has its positive control - the same text without that wait bit
